_comment: MY per-part understanding, in plain language, for the user to check and correct.
The bench SYNTHESISES a baseline for every part from its role, title and dimensions
(see ROLE_DEF / ROLE_MODEL in part.js). This file is the hand-written layer on top:
where I have looked hard at a part, I write what it is, how I model it, how it fits,
and -- kept honest and separate -- what is DERIVED (read off a manual/photo/dimension),
what is ASSUMED (my inference, could be wrong), and what is UNKNOWN.
Only parts I have actually studied need an entry. A missing entry is not an error;
it means the bench is showing the role-based baseline and I have not reviewed it yet.
Give feedback against any line and I will move it between derived/assumed/unknown or fix it.
Fields: what, model, fits, confidence(high|medium|low), derived[], assumed[], unknown[].

ST-050.what: The Jikaro Fire Ring Table: an octagonal table (1120mm across, 400mm tall) with an open centre for a fire pit or ring, standing on eight wire legs. RECONFIGURABLE: the four trapezoid segments go together two ways -- spread (long edge in: 1120 across, 600 opening) or compact (short edge in: 885 across, 365 opening). The open centre only becomes usable IGT space with an OPTIONAL bridge (2-Unit CPL-JT2U over the 600 opening, or 1-Unit ST-051 over the 365).
ST-050.model: jikaroGroup -- one octagon ring (outer/opening/edge driven by the chosen config, extruded flat) on eight U-hairpin legs. Each hairpin runs ALONG one of the trapezoid's two 285mm slant edges (inner hole corner out to the outer flat corner) -- two per segment, eight in all -- dropping to a foot bar with a shallow centre notch. When a bridge is on, jikaroBridge lays two stainless brackets across the opening with the slide-in bars dividing it into 1 or 2 IGT units.
ST-050.fits: Standalone. It does not hook to the frame rail; Snow Peak groups it with the layout tables by height (400mm datum). Its OWN centre, bridged, hosts IGT unit accessories (1U compact / 2U spread). A Bamboo IGT Table can also hook to one outer 365mm edge (a011).
derived: octagon outline and the central opening are traced off the top-view photograph
overall 1120mm and height 400mm are from the catalogue

two assembly configs (long-edge-in 1120/600, short-edge-in 885/365) reconstructed from the two plan photos a007/a008 at their two scales, cross-checked against the segment invariant and the spec table

eight U-hairpin legs running ALONG the trapezoid slant (short) edges, two per segment -- from the disassembled photo a009 AND the user's explicit correction; the pair marks D,E land on the OUTER end of the +x pair of slants, repeated to all eight by the octagon's four-fold symmetry
the bridge is a real optional accessory (ST-051 1U / CPL-JT2U 2U); opening size decides which fits (600->2U, 365->1U), confirmed against the IGT W=250n+96 formula

it joins via BUILT-IN SIDE KNOBS (ツマミ, in the material spec), NOT the frame's wire hook -- the `knob` interface, symmetric, no CK-175. This is the SAME joint its four trapezoid segments use, so its outer edges are the same port (owner correction; earlier this was wrongly modelled as the wire hook). Only the Jikaro + Connection Table (LV-381) have it. See layout.connections.
assumed: opening 600mm and slant-edge 365mm outer / 285mm slant / 260mm depth (ring proportions from the photo + the trapezoid math)
the two wires sit at 16% and 95% along each slant, dropping vertically (D,E fix the outer end; the inner-wire spot and the foot notch are eyeballed off a009)
the bridge is modelled schematically (2 brackets + N bars); exact bracket profile from the CPL-JT2U spec (635x115 bracket, 360x47 bars)
unknown: exact wire spacing along the slant and how vertical vs splayed the drop is -- two noisy outer marks don't pin the inner wire
the official Snow Peak SKU of the 2-Unit bridge (a SEPPOUSAI festival limited; CPL-JT2U is the after-market equivalent)

CK-153TR.what: Renewed Bamboo IGT Sliding Extension (short): a small bamboo board (423x220) that grips the frame's long rail and cantilevers outward, adding a shelf beside the table.
CK-153TR.model: slideExtGroup -- a bamboo slab with two under-brackets that clip over the rail; the board top carries the real grain/logo texture (from the alt_02 top-view photo).
CK-153TR.fits: Clips onto the frame's LONG side (the rail), not the short end. Slides freely along the rail (the planner snaps it in 25mm steps). Two CK-153TR end to end span the same length as a Three Unit Frame (846mm).
derived: dimensions 423x220x33 from the catalogue
top texture is the real alt_02 orthographic top view
mounts on the long rail (manual/photo)
assumed: bracket shape and the 220mm cantilever reach
25mm slide snap is a planner convenience, not a real detent
unknown: how far two of them must overlap/space to avoid fouling each other on the same rail

CK-154TR.what: Renewed Bamboo IGT Sliding Extension Long: the longer sibling of CK-153TR (548x220), same idea -- a bamboo board that grips the rail and reaches out.
CK-154TR.model: slideExtGroup, same builder as CK-153TR, longer board.
CK-154TR.fits: Clips onto the frame's LONG rail and slides. Two CK-154TR end to end span the same length as a Four Unit Frame (1096mm).
derived: dimensions 548x220x33 from the catalogue
two of them = Four Unit Frame length (1096mm)
assumed: bracket shape and cantilever reach, shared with CK-153TR
unknown: overlap/spacing rule when several share one rail

CK-117TR.what: Renewed Bamboo IGT Table Long: a full-length (1096mm) bamboo tabletop that hooks onto a frame end and runs the length out -- the four-unit extension surface.
CK-117TR.model: tableGroup -- a flat bamboo slab, with the plan-view photo laid under it in the same frame so the hook and bracket positions can be checked against the board.
CK-117TR.fits: Hooks onto the frame's SHORT end (its hooks drop into the black end pieces) and carries straight on for four units. Takes its host frame's leg SKU.
derived: 1096mm = four units (250*4+96) from the dimension
hooks on the short end, from the frame-fittings plan view
assumed: exact hook mm positions where not yet measured off a photo

CK-116TR.what: Renewed Bamboo IGT Table Regular: the 846mm (three-unit) bamboo tabletop; same as CK-117TR one size down.
CK-116TR.model: tableGroup -- flat bamboo slab with the plan view underlaid.
CK-116TR.fits: Hooks onto the frame's short end and carries on for three units.
derived: 846mm = three units (250*3+96)
assumed: exact hook positions where unmeasured

CK-119TR.what: Bamboo Right Corner Extension: a 496mm square bamboo board that turns the run 90 degrees at a corner (the LEFT-hand version is CK-118TR).
CK-119TR.model: tableGroup -- a square flat slab. The corner turn is what makes it special: its hook edge and bracket edge are PERPENDICULAR, so the layout changes direction through it.
CK-119TR.fits: Hooks on one edge, offers brackets on an adjacent (not opposite) edge, so the run leaves at 90 degrees. Left/right decides which way it turns.
derived: 496mm square from the catalogue
corner (perpendicular hook vs bracket edge) from the role and the plan view
assumed: which physical edge is hook vs bracket for R vs L, where not yet measured

CK-150.what: IGT Four Unit Frame: the rigid four-unit (1096mm) leg frame -- the backbone a run is built on. Silver corner plates carry the leg sockets; black end pieces carry the holes an extension's hooks drop into.
CK-150.model: frameGroup -- the frame cross-section swept to length, with the hook-holes along the ends and sockets at the corners.
CK-150.fits: The central node: takes legs at the corners, extensions hook onto its short ends, sliding boards clip on its long rails, and frames join frame-to-frame via the rail joint (XCK-128).
derived: 1096mm = four units
hook-holes on the ends and leg sockets at corners, from the underside plan view
assumed: exact cross-section profile where read off a single photo

CK-149.what: IGT Three Unit Frame: the 846mm rigid frame; CK-150 one size down.
CK-149.fits: Same as CK-150: legs at corners, extensions on the ends, boards on the rails, joins to other frames.
derived: 846mm = three units
assumed: cross-section profile detail

CK-904.what: Collapsible IGT 4 Unit Frame: the folding version of the four-unit frame -- rails that collapse for packing rather than a rigid weld.
CK-904.fits: Same role as CK-150 (legs, extensions, rails, frame joints) but folds flat; pairs with the collapsible rails (CK-904-1).
derived: 1096mm = four units
collapsible, from the title and the separate rails part
assumed: how the fold changes the rail cross-section vs the rigid frame

CK-080R.what: Entry IGT: an all-in-one starter IGT (833x440x400) that is really a 3-UNIT IGT FRAME in a fixed body. Aluminium frame on TWO built-in folding TUBE legs; its bamboo top LIFTS OUT (2x one-unit + 2x half-unit pieces, custom, no SKU) so standard IGT units drop into the frame -- which is what makes it an IGT. Fixed height; the legs fold, they don't come off.
CK-080R.model: entryIgtGroup builds the aluminium frame ring + two folding tube legs; the removable bamboo top is drawn by igtWoodTop, one tile per FREE half-unit across the 3-unit run, so a dropped module simply takes a tile's place. Modules render via the shared drawModules.
CK-080R.fits: Standalone unit with its own legs (no separate leg SKU). It IS a 3-unit frame: select it and the module palette + slot [+] handles light up; drop a burner/tray and the bamboo there lifts out. ~41mm end margins round the 750mm 3-unit run.
derived: aluminium frame + bamboo top + two folding tube legs (photo 04977 / frame-only 04978)
833x440x400 from the catalogue
3 units, removable tops = 2x one-unit + 2x half-unit bamboo, and 'IGTユニットサイズの製品がテーブルフレーム内に組み込めます' (units fit inside the frame) -- from CK-080R's manual set-contents
assumed: the top is tiled per half-unit for the model (the real pieces are 2 full + 2 half); leg splay ~18mm out / 34mm inset, eyeballed
unknown: the exact folding-leg bend and hinge detail
how the units seat (rail ledge vs the frame lip) -- modelled resting in the frame

CK-080R-EC.what: Entry IGT in Black: the CK-080R in a black finish. Same all-in-one 3-unit IGT frame with a removable bamboo top, on two built-in folding tube legs.
CK-080R-EC.fits: Standalone 3-unit frame with its own folding legs; a black-finish variant of CK-080R. Same removable-top hosting.
derived: same part as CK-080R, black finish; 833x440x400; 3 units
assumed: modelled identically to CK-080R (finish colour aside)

CK-180.what: IGT Slim: the slim, light IGT (940x403x408) that is a 3-UNIT IGT FRAME -- NO long-side rails, two dark teak end caps and thin support rods, on TWO built-in folding THIN-WIRE legs. Its top is SIX removable half-unit teak panels; any panel lifts out for a stovetop or workspace. Fixed height; the wire legs fold.
CK-180.model: slimIgtGroup builds the dark end caps + support rods + two folding wire legs; the SIX removable teak panels are drawn by igtWoodTop (one tile per free half-unit across the 3-unit run, ACROSS the width -- an earlier version wrongly ran seven slats lengthwise). Modules render via drawModules.
CK-180.fits: Standalone 3-unit frame with its own legs. No long-side rail, so external IGT accessories can't hook its long sides the way they do on a real frame -- but its OWN top lifts out per half-unit for units. Select it and the module palette + slot handles light up.
derived: no long-side rail; dark teak end caps; thin black wire folding legs (hero photo)
940x403x408 from the catalogue
a 3-unit frame with SIX removable half-unit teak panels, any of which lifts out for a stovetop/workspace (Snow Peak product copy)
assumed: wire-leg splay ~44mm out, eyeballed off the hero
how the units seat given there is no long rail -- modelled resting between the end supports
unknown: the exact wire-leg shape and how the short ends carry the panels

CK-090.what: Extension IGT: a self-contained table of TWO laminated-bamboo tops on one aluminium stand, on built-in folding tube legs. RECONFIGURABLE by sliding: closed it is a plain ~3-unit table (840x498); slid fully open (1348x498) the two tops part to expose a central 2-Unit IGT bay (500x360) between them. The catalogue title carries a 'Risk of tipping over' warning -- the open span is cantilevered.
CK-090.model: extIgtGroup -- an aluminium frame ring + two bamboo tops (one each side of the centre), fixed folding tube legs at the ends. When expanded, two silver rails bridge the gap to frame the 2-Unit bay; when collapsed the tops meet and there is no bay. footprint and bay follow the chosen config (layout.expandables.CK-090).
CK-090.fits: Standalone unit with its own legs (no separate leg SKU). Expanded, its centre bay hosts IGT unit accessories -- the point of the part. Stands at the 400mm datum, so it joins the layout as a node.
derived: two bamboo tops on an aluminium stand with folding legs (hero 04977 + alt 06)
max 1348x498 / min 840x498 and the central (2ユニット=W)500x360 bay -- straight from the manual set-contents
the 508mm the tops travel = exactly the 2-Unit (500mm) opening; 840~=3 units, 1348~=5 units by W=250n+96
assumed: two-panel split with the bay dead-centre; leg splay reused from the entry IGT, eyeballed
the collapsed form is a usable flat table (vs merely a carry state)
unknown: the exact slide/stand mechanism and how the tops lock at each end of travel
whether intermediate opening widths are usable or only the two detents

ST-051.what: Jikaro Table 1 Unit Bridge: the OPTIONAL stainless bridge that lays across the compact (short-edge-in, 365mm opening) Jikaro to turn its fire hole into ONE IGT unit-slot. Official Snow Peak SKU, now rare.
ST-051.model: jikaroBridge (units=1) -- two brackets over the opening + one slide-in bar. NOT a placeable node: like the connection hook and rail joint it cannot stand alone, so it is a toggle on a Jikaro (ST-050) and shows up in that Jikaro's parts list. See layout.bridges.
ST-051.fits: Only on a Jikaro in the compact/'square' config (365mm opening). Provides 1 IGT unit for a burner or tray in the table's centre.
derived: a real optional 1-Unit bridge for the Jikaro (Amazon/JP listings, SKU ST-051 -- sits next to ST-050)
1 IGT unit, matched to the 365mm compact opening
assumed: modelled schematically (2 brackets + 1 bar) by analogy to the 2-Unit CPL-JT2U spec; no published dimensions for the 1-Unit
unknown: its exact dimensions and bracket profile

CPL-JT2U.what: Jikaro Top 2 Unit Bridge: the OPTIONAL stainless bridge that lays across the spread (long-edge-in, 600mm opening) Jikaro to turn its fire hole into a 2-Unit IGT bay. The official version is a SEPPOUSAI (Snow Peak Festival) 2023 Autumn limited edition; CPL-JT2U is the after-market equivalent.
CPL-JT2U.model: jikaroBridge (units=2) -- two brackets over the opening + two slide-in bars at the unit divisions. NOT a placeable node: a toggle on a Jikaro (ST-050), reflected in its parts list. See layout.bridges.
CPL-JT2U.fits: Only on a Jikaro in the spread config (600mm opening). Provides 2 IGT units (or a 1/2-unit appliance) in the table's centre.
derived: a real optional 2-Unit bridge (BIGTENT CPL-JT2U; official = festival limited)
2 IGT units, matched to the 600mm spread opening
stainless, 2 main brackets 635x115mm + 2 bridge bars 360x47mm, ~1.9kg, 20kg load, brackets rest over the opening and the bars slide into their grooves (product spec)
assumed: modelled schematically -- bracket length = opening + rim overlap; bars at the unit centres
unknown: the official Snow Peak festival SKU code

GS-450R-US.what: Flat Burner: a low, flat single-burner stove sized to drop into two IGT units (270x410), sitting flush in the frame like a tabletop.
GS-450R-US.model: moduleGroup (a slot module) with a real top texture cropped from the burner's own top-view photo.
GS-450R-US.fits: Drops into the frame as a 2-unit slot module -- its rim rests on the rails, the body hangs below.
derived: 270x410 = 2 units wide
top texture from the a016 top-view photo
assumed: how deep the body hangs below the rail line

XCK-128-01.what: Multi Function Table Rail Joint (2-piece set): the little joint that ties one frame's long rail to the next, so two frames read as one continuous run.
XCK-128-01.model: plateGroup -- a small connecting plate; it is hardware, not a surface.
XCK-128-01.fits: Joins frame long-rail to frame long-rail. It is why frames line up side by side; without it they are just two tables near each other.
derived: joins the long rails, from the manual
assumed: exact plate geometry (modelled as a generic plate)

GF-010.what: Garden Unit Table Wood Insert: a wood insert for the Garden Unit Table. Currently EXCLUDED from the planner.
GF-010.fits: Excluded -- it belongs to the Garden Unit Table ecosystem, which the planner does not cover yet.
derived: excluded, by decision
